about: The collecta of the formulary “Vigil of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who gladdenest us each year with the expectation of our redemption, grant that we who joyfully receive Thine Only-begotten as our Redeemer may also behold Him without fear when He cometh as Judge, our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: for a year, lasting/appointed for a year
